title: RuleChainData
description: A JSON value representing the rule chains.

ruleChains.description: List of the Rule Chain objects.

metadata.description: List of the Rule Chain metadata objects.

JsonNode.description: A value representing the any type (object or primitive)

fromIndex.description: Index of rule node in the 'nodes' array of the RuleChainMetaData. Indicates the 'from' part of the connection.

toIndex.description: Index of rule node in the 'nodes' array of the RuleChainMetaData. Indicates the 'to' part of the connection.

type.description: Type of the relation. Typically indicated the result of processing by the 'from' rule node. For example, 'Success' or 'Failure'

RuleChain.description: A JSON value representing the rule chain.

id.description: JSON object with the Rule Chain Id. Specify this field to update the Rule Chain. Referencing non-existing Rule Chain Id will cause error. Omit this field to create new rule chain.

createdTime.description: Timestamp of the rule chain creation, in milliseconds

type.description: Rule Chain type. 'EDGE' rule chains are processing messages on the edge devices only.

firstRuleNodeId.description: JSON object with Rule Chain Id. Pointer to the first rule node that should receive all messages pushed to this rule chain.

root.description: Indicates root rule chain. The root rule chain process messages from all devices and entities by default. User may configure default rule chain per device profile.

fromIndex.description: Index of rule node in the 'nodes' array of the RuleChainMetaData. Indicates the 'from' part of the connection.

targetRuleChainId.description: JSON object with the Rule Chain Id.

additionalInfo.description: JSON object with the additional information about the connection.

type.description: Type of the relation. Typically indicated the result of processing by the 'from' rule node. For example, 'Success' or 'Failure'

id.description: ID of the entity, time-based UUID v1

RuleChainMetaData.description: A JSON value representing the rule chain metadata.

ruleChainId.description: JSON object with Rule Chain Id.

firstNodeIndex.description: Index of the first rule node in the 'nodes' list

nodes.description: List of rule node JSON objects

connections.description: List of JSON objects that represent connections between rule nodes

ruleChainConnections.description: List of JSON objects that represent connections between rule nodes and other rule chains.

id.description: JSON object with the Rule Node Id. Specify this field to update the Rule Node. Referencing non-existing Rule Node Id will cause error. Omit this field to create new rule node.

createdTime.description: Timestamp of the rule node creation, in milliseconds

ruleChainId.description: JSON object with the Rule Chain Id.

type.description: Full Java Class Name of the rule node implementation.

name.description: User defined name of the rule node. Used on UI and for logging.

additionalInfo.description: Additional parameters of the rule node. Contains 'layoutX' and 'layoutY' properties for visualization.

id.description: ID of the entity, time-based UUID v1
